text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains. Try not to eat too much sugar or fast food. Second, do exercise regularly. Even a short walk every day can help you stay fit. Third, get enough sleep, because your body needs rest to work well. Do not forget your mental health: talk to friends, relax, and take breaks when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance. Spend time on your job, but also enjoy your hobbies and family. These simple habits can make you happier and healthier.
